Vijay's film 'Jana Nayagan' faces screening dispute amid high advance bookings

The film 'Jana Nayagan', starring Vijay, has generated significant buzz with high advance ticket sales, reportedly selling over 3 lakh tickets and earning crores in pre-release business. However, one cinema hall in Bengaluru has declined to screen the movie due to a distribution dispute. Meanwhile, ticket prices have varied, with some reportedly soaring to ₹2500 while others are capped at ₹190 in Tamil Nadu, and the cheapest available at ₹54.
